title: Harusame Salad (Japanese Glass Noodle Salad) 春雨サラダ
summary: This Japanese Glass Noodle Salad (Harusame Salad) recipe is light, refreshing, low calorie, and so flavorful with a savory and tangy sesame soy vinaigrette.

title: Japanese Garlic Fried Rice ガーリックライス
summary: Aromatic and buttery, this easy Japanese Garlic Fried Rice recipe topped with garlic chips is a weeknight winner! It is simple yet indulgent. Pair it with succulent grilled shrimp skewers, baked chicken, or teriyaki tofu for a wholesome meal. Ready in 15 minutes!

title: Meyer Lemon Cookies (Video) マイヤーレモンサブレ

title: Chicken Tempura (Toriten) とり天 (Video)
summary: Chicken Tempura is a regional favorite in Oita Prefecture of Kyushu region in Japan. With a crispy and fluffy batter on the outside and juicy and tender meat inside, this Chicken Tempura is best enjoyed by dipping with karashi mustard ponzu sauce.

title: Monkfish Hot Pot (Anko Nabe) あんこう鍋
summary: Experience the warmest communal dining at home with this incredibly flavorful Japanese Monkfish Hot Pot called Anko Nabe. The rich soup broth will blow you away. Such a fun way to cook and eat together, it‘s one of our family's favorite meals in the winter months!

title: Purin Dora (Dorayaki with Custard Pudding) ぷりんどら

title: Miso Soup with Yuzu Kosho (Video) 柚子胡椒入り味噌汁

title: Cherry Blossom Milk Pudding 桜ミルクプリン

title: Karaage Rice Bowl 中華風唐揚げ丼

The chicken is marinated in a Chinese seasoning of soy sauce, ginger, sweet bean sauce, and sesame oil before frying to golden and coated with a savory scrumptious sauce.

title: Okinawa Soba 沖縄そば

title: Kimchi Gyoza Nabe (Hot Pot) キムチ餃子鍋
